chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Muʾaddib, who said: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from al-Naḍr ibn Shuʿayb, from Jamīl ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you are able to perform one thousand rakʿahs in the day and night during the month of Ramaḍān and other than it, then do so, for indeed ʿAlī عليه السلام used to perform one thousand rakʿahs in the day and night.

key_terms.أَلْفَ رَكْعَةٍ: one thousand units of prayer, indicating a very large amount of supererogatory salat
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ: the full span of a day and night
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, highlighted as a special time for increased worship
key_terms.عَلِيًّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, cited as the model of this devotional practice
key_terms.فَافْعَلْ: then do it; an exhortation to act upon the recommended worship

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about performing one thousand rakʿahs in a day and night during Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages abundant salat (prayer), especially in the month of Ramaḍān, while also extending the recommendation beyond it. It presents the practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as an exemplar of intense devotion and supererogatory worship.
